messages:
sophie lim: FYI we have an onsite for candidate Luis Ortega (Madrid) on Mon 2026-05-11. He requested an official invitation letter for visa entry and confirmation of hotel. Can Travel & People Ops help?
diego marquez: I can handle airport pickup on 5/10 evening (SFO arrival 19:40). Will need hotel confirmation number and guest name to give to driver.
jen park: Ill generate the invitation letter and loop in finance for per-diem/relocation questions. Does he need a visa letter (B1/B2) or employer sponsorship?
sophie lim: He asked for a standard invitation letter for business travel (B1/B2). No sponsorship. Also asked whether Redwood can pre-pay the hotel or if he should expense.
travel-bot: Policy note: Redwood can pre-pay hotels for international candidates up to 2 nights when requested. Please submit Travel Request -> https://redwood.internal/travel with candidate name and dates.
jen park: Submitted travel request for pre-payment (TR-2026-351). Hotel tentative: Orchard Suites SFO, check-in 2026-05-10, check-out 2026-05-12.
sophie lim: Also flag: Luis prefers Spanish interpreter for the first interview. Any bilingual interviewers?
diego marquez: I speak Spanish and can be on the intro panel 9:00-9:30. Will arrange interpreter for system-design if needed.
recruiter-bot: Calendar invite created: 2026-05-11T09:00:00-07:00 to 2026-05-11T16:00:00-07:00. Panels: Diego M., Mira P., Sam O., QA TBD. Zoom link included for remote fallback.
jen park: Invitation letter (PDF) attached to candidate email and travel request. Text snippet in email: 
``
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference invites Mr. Luis Ortega to attend onsite interviews at our San Francisco office on May 11, 2026. Redwood will cover up to two nights hotel and local transportation.
``
Please review and let me know edits.
security-bot: Visitor badge request created -> https://redwood.internal/badges/requests/1784750011 (escort required).
sophie lim: Can Recruiting confirm whether he needs a SIM/local phone or we reimburse taxi from airport? He prefers pre-booked car service.
jen park: Car service booked via approved vendor (CONF-448). We'll pre-pay and include in travel packet. Taxi reimbursement policy: receipts required; under $100 auto-approve.
diego marquez: Parking note for driver: meet at SFO Arrivals, Door 4. I will text him the pick-up details day-of.
sophie lim: Add accessibility note: candidate has a heavy luggage case and prefers elevator access. Facilities please reserve ground-floor elevator key.
recruiter-bot: Added "remote fallback" instructions to invite: if flight delayed, full remote day via Zoom at same times; panelers keep windows free.
jen park: Final item: candidate asked if interim remote interview is possible in Madrid for a few panels before travel. Recruiter to confirm. If yes, we'll split onsite to hands-on + final loop only.
diego marquez: Fine with split. Ill keep 1:00-1:45 as in-person hands-on only if he travels.
security-bot: Badge approved at 08:12 on 2026-05-10. Loaner laptop available on request (Asset TAG LB-3321).
sophie lim: Thanks team. I'll send Luis the invite + PDF letter + travel packet today and cc Travel/Finance. Please update this thread if any changes. :white_check_mark:
